text:
alex: Quick q on /v2/rerank scoring semantics — doc currently says 'score: float' but doesn't state sign constraints. Are negatives allowed? Also what's recommended client fallback when score is null? Planning a canary and need client guidance. /cc @maria @devon
maria: score can be negative — it's a model logit-style score, not a probability. Use it only for relative ordering. If null -> treat as missing score and do not reorder.
devon: Agree. Missing/null score => preserve input order (stable fallback). We decided earlier to avoid reordering on missing scores to avoid UX surprises. @jules correct?
jules: Yep. Implementation note: server will return `score: null` for items we couldn't score. We also add `tie_id`/`tie_meta` for deterministic tie info. Clients should: 1) if score present -> sort desc; 2) if equal scores -> use `tie_id`/tie_meta if present; 3) if score null -> keep input order. :white_check_mark: 
alex: Thanks. On ties: are smaller or larger score = better? The docs didn't state descending/ascending. Let's make that explicit.
maria: Larger is better — higher score = better ranking. We'll add `score_order: \"desc\"` to examples.
sam_prod: Product note: when clients can't implement deterministic tie-breaker, they should fall back to stable-sort by index (preserve). That's important for A/B test consistency. Can we add that guidance in SDKs?
eva: SDKs: we'll add a helper `stableRerank(items, resp)` that applies server tie metadata if available, else preserves order. I'll open a PR after the canary.
devon: One more edge: floating precision differences between languages can cause different tie results. The server-provided `tie_id` should be authoritative. We'll include `tie_hash` when applicable instead of relying on floats.
alex: Example request/response? paste a tiny sample pls.
jules: ```json
Request:
{
  "items": [{"id":"p1","text":"..."},
            {"id":"p2","text":"..."}],
  "params": {"return_meta": true}
}

Response:
{
  "items": [
    {"id":"p1","score":0.12, "tie_id":"p1"},
    {"id":"p2","score":0.12, "tie_id":"p2"}
  ],
  "score_order":"desc"
}
```
We will also include `score_null_reason` when score is null (e.g. "timeout", "oom").
alex: :eyes: Good. For canary: what's server behavior when a model variant can't produce scores (memory/timeout)?
jules: It will return `score:null` and `score_null_reason: "timeout"` or `"oom"` so clients and logs can surface. Canary will emit counters for nulls per model.
deploy-bot: deploy: canary/rerank-variant-2026-03-15 started in us-west. Link: https://deploys.internal/1234
sam_prod: :thumbsup: Can we add a telemetry event `score_missing` with item count and model version? That'll help QA and rollbacks.
devon: Yes, telemetry event planned. Also note we guarantee deterministic `tie_id` values across reruns for same item id + model version, so client-side stable sorting will be consistent.
alex: Great. I'll draft SDK guidance and ping for doc PR. Thanks everyone.
